target.jobDescription:
Join Meijer’s 11-week IT internship program to gain hands-on experience in software development, IT operations, and infrastructure within a community-focused company.

Your Role
Here’s what you will be doing:

Work on challenging and impactful projects in Digital Solutions, Applications Development, Operations, and Infrastructure.
Design, code, test, and implement software applications supporting Digital Shopping, Pharmacy, Finance, Merchandising, Supply Chain, and Corporate systems.
Engage with IT Operations and Infrastructure teams managing network, cloud services, mainframes, middleware, monitoring, data warehouses, and client services.
Utilize cloud-based technologies, cognitive automation, machine learning, and AI for issue detection and self-healing.
Deliver final presentations to senior executives and participate in executive speaker series and networking events.
About You
The company is looking for candidates who have:

Progress toward a bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Information Security/Cyber Security, or related Computer Engineering degree.
Customer focus and dedication to meeting internal and external customer expectations.
Strong relationship skills to create positive working relationships with customers, team members, leadership, and other constituencies.
Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.
Preferred skills for Applications Development: Microsoft Technologies (Azure, .NET, ASP.Net, C#, MS Office365, SharePoint, SQL, SSRS, SSIS), Java, REST/Web APIs, Adobe AEM, modern design patterns (MVC), frameworks (jQuery, AngularJS), mobile development (native iOS and Android), enterprise solutions (SAP, Workday), Agile methodology.
Preferred skills for Operations and Infrastructure: Basic understanding of distributed systems architecture, PC and mobile device configuration, telecommunications, network technologies, cloud technologies, network management, and performance monitoring tools.
Compensation & Benefits
Weekly pay
Scheduling flexibility
Paid parental leave
Paid education assistance
Team member discount
Development programs for advancement and career growth
Training & Development
11-week internship program with diverse personal and professional development opportunities.
Professional development and training opportunities.
Interaction with other interns and Meijer senior leaders.
Executive speaker series and networking/community events.
